_note: Cross-file duplication that is accepted. Every entry needs a reason; an unexplained entry means a rule has two owners. Regenerate a sha with tests/test_prompt_graph.py's reporter.

approved.sample: critical read claude plugin root core guardrails md first shared rules not repeated here on top of those
approved.reason: The pointer to core/guardrails.md must exist verbatim in every command file — it is the delegation itself, not a rule. Extracting it would mean a file telling the agent to read the file it is already reading.

approved.sample: glab api projects owner 2f repo merge requests pull number changes jq
approved.reason: One endpoint deliberately serves two entries — the size list and the gated patch — so each carries the same URL with a different jq program. Collapsing them would leave one entry without a runnable command, which vendor_lint.py requires.

approved.sample: obey verbatim every step in order arguments handed to this skill are that file s usage block forbidden
approved.reason: Shim boilerplate. Each platform demands its own entry file, and all four say the same two things: read adapters/root.md, then obey src/commands/<cmd>.md verbatim. The rules themselves have exactly one owner under src/ — collapsing the four shims into one would cost every platform its per-command slash entry.
